description: Cross-harness matrix suite for the frontend plugin's 15 skills (angular, angular-signals, astro, blazor, gatsby, htmx, nextjs, nextjs-app-router, nuxt, overview, react, react-server-components, remix, svelte, vue). Prompts are deliberately neutral (no mention of a skills library or docs) so the no-skill arm is not tipped off. Every expected answer is traceable to cited content shipped in each skill's SKILL.md as of 2026-08-09. knowledge: 'recent' = fact a bare model plausibly lacks (post-cutoff or niche version detail); 'stable' = long-standing fact a strong bare model may already know.

tasks.prompt: In Angular, which single change detection strategy is described as the highest-impact performance optimization to set on every component? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/angular/SKILL.md - Always use ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, the single highest-impact performance optimization

tasks.prompt: As of Angular 21, which test runner became the default, replacing the older Karma-based setup? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/angular/SKILL.md - version table: Angular 21 makes Vitest the default test runner

tasks.prompt: Angular 21 removed a long-standing library that had been used for touch and gesture handling. Which library was removed? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/angular/SKILL.md - version table: Angular 21 - HammerJS removed

tasks.prompt: Angular first shipped signal, computed, and effect as a developer preview in which major version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/angular-signals/SKILL.md - Version History table: v16 Developer Preview of signal(), computed(), effect()

tasks.prompt: In Angular signals, which major version first introduced the resource and rxResource APIs for async data? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/angular-signals/SKILL.md - Version History table: v19 introduced resource()/rxResource()

tasks.prompt: In an Angular resource, once the loader has finished and data is available without error, what status value does the resource report? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/angular-signals/SKILL.md - Status values: idle, loading, reloading, resolved, error, local

tasks.prompt: In Astro, which client hydration directive waits until the component scrolls into the viewport before hydrating it? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/astro/SKILL.md - directive table: client:visible hydrates when element enters viewport

tasks.prompt: In Astro 5, at what file path do you define content collection configuration, replacing the old version 4 location? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/astro/SKILL.md - pitfall 3: Astro 5 uses src/content.config.ts, not src/content/config.ts from v4

tasks.prompt: For Astro Server Islands, what environment variable name should you set to keep prop encryption stable across separate deployments? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/astro/SKILL.md - Server Islands section: use ASTRO_KEY for stable encryption across deployments

tasks.prompt: Roughly how large, in compressed megabytes, is the baseline Blazor WebAssembly runtime download before any app code is added? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/blazor/SKILL.md - WebAssembly Runtime section: Baseline WASM download is ~2 MB compressed

tasks.prompt: Dot NET 10 shipped a much smaller JavaScript bundle for Blazor Interactive Server circuits. By roughly what percentage did the bundle shrink? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/blazor/SKILL.md - version table: .NET 10 - 76% smaller JS bundle

tasks.prompt: Which new attribute did dot NET 10 add to Blazor for persisting component state across the prerender-to-interactive handoff? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/blazor/SKILL.md - version table and pitfall 1: [PersistentState] attribute added in .NET 10

tasks.prompt: Which company acquired Gatsby Inc in February 2023? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/gatsby/SKILL.md - Status section: Feb 2023 Netlify acquired Gatsby Inc

tasks.prompt: Gatsby 5 requires Node.js 18. When did Node.js 18 reach end of life? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/gatsby/SKILL.md - Status section: Node.js 18 (required by Gatsby 5) reached EOL April 2025

tasks.prompt: For a mostly static, content-focused site currently built on Gatsby, which modern framework is recommended as the migration target to minimize JavaScript? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/gatsby/SKILL.md - Migration Targets: Astro for content/docs sites, minimal interactivity

tasks.prompt: In HTMX, absent an explicit hx-trigger attribute, what event by default triggers a request from a text input element? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/htmx/SKILL.md - hx-trigger section: default is change for inputs

tasks.prompt: In HTMX 2.0, is the selfRequestsOnly configuration option true or false by default? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/htmx/SKILL.md - Security section and pitfall 4: selfRequestsOnly default true in 2.0

tasks.prompt: In HTMX 2.0, how does a DELETE request send its parameters, compared with HTMX 1.x which put them in the request body? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/htmx/SKILL.md - pitfall 6: DELETE sends URL/query parameters in 2.0, body in 1.x

tasks.prompt: Starting with Next.js 15, is a plain fetch call inside a Server Component cached by default, or not cached by default? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nextjs/SKILL.md - Caching Model: v15+ does NOT cache by default (no-store)

tasks.prompt: In Next.js 16, which file replaces middleware.ts, and what runtime does it execute on instead of the Edge Runtime? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nextjs/SKILL.md - Middleware and Proxy table: v16 uses proxy.ts on the Node.js Runtime

tasks.prompt: Next.js provides an automated codemod to migrate synchronous access to cookies, headers, and params to the new async APIs. What is the codemod named? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nextjs/SKILL.md - pitfall 2: run the codemod npx @next/codemod@canary next-async-request-api .

tasks.prompt: In the Next.js App Router, which special file acts as a React Error Boundary for a route segment and must itself be a Client Component? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nextjs-app-router/SKILL.md - file conventions table: error.tsx is the Error Boundary, must be Client Component

tasks.prompt: In the Next.js App Router intercepting routes syntax, which folder prefix intercepts relative to the application root, as opposed to one or two levels up? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nextjs-app-router/SKILL.md - Intercepting Routes prefix table: (...) intercepts relative to application root

tasks.prompt: In the Next.js App Router, what file must you add inside a parallel route slot to prevent a full page 404 when that slot has no match for the current URL? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nextjs-app-router/SKILL.md - Parallel Routes section: default.tsx required for unmatched slots

tasks.prompt: In Nuxt, for a server handler file like hello.post.ts under the server api directory, what part of the filename tells Nitro which HTTP method to register? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nuxt/SKILL.md - Nitro Server Engine: HTTP method is inferred from filename suffix

tasks.prompt: In Nuxt 4, what does the framework use as the default ref behavior in place of the deep reactive refs from Nuxt 3? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nuxt/SKILL.md - version table and intro: Nuxt 4 makes shallowRef the default

tasks.prompt: Roughly how many hosting targets can a Nuxt Nitro build output be deployed to? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/nuxt/SKILL.md - Nitro Server Engine: portable across 15+ hosting targets

tasks.prompt: Which rendering model, used primarily by Astro, serves static HTML by default and hydrates only the components that need interactivity? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Rendering Models table: Islands row, framework support Astro

tasks.prompt: Per general frontend guidance, which framework uses a proxy-based reactivity system that tracks property access on reactive objects, as distinct from virtual DOM diffing or a compiler-driven approach? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Reactivity Systems table: Proxy-based row, Vue 3

tasks.prompt: Per general frontend guidance, which specific React version paired with which routing system is currently needed to run React Server Components in a production app? Answer concisely with both.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Rendering Models table: RSC row, framework support React 19 + Next.js App Router

tasks.prompt: In React, which single capability still has no hook equivalent and requires a class component? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/react/SKILL.md - Core Expertise bullets: Error boundaries (class-only API)

tasks.prompt: In React 19, has the legacy ReactDOM.render API been removed, or is it still supported alongside createRoot? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/react/SKILL.md - Concurrent Features: ReactDOM.render is removed in 19

tasks.prompt: In React 19, what is the name of the new hook that lets you show an optimistic UI state while an async action is still pending? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/react/SKILL.md - React 19 hooks list: useActionState, useOptimistic, useFormStatus, use()

tasks.prompt: Can a Client Component directly import a Server Component as a module dependency, or does that fail to build? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/react-server-components/SKILL.md - Boundary rules: Client Component CANNOT import Server Components (build error)

tasks.prompt: React Server Components became stable starting in which major version of React? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/react-server-components/SKILL.md - intro: RSC, stable in React 19

tasks.prompt: Which directive do you place on a function to mark it as a Server Action that is callable from Client Components? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/react-server-components/SKILL.md - Directive Summary table: use server marks Server Actions

tasks.prompt: If a Form with method post targets a route module that exports no action function, what HTTP status code results? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/remix/SKILL.md - pitfall 1: missing action export gives 405 Method Not Allowed

tasks.prompt: In what year did Remix v2 rebrand into React Router v7, keeping the same team and the same API? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/remix/SKILL.md - intro: Remix v2 rebranded to React Router v7 in late 2024

tasks.prompt: Why does the root level ErrorBoundary in React Router v7 or Remix need to render a complete document, unlike error boundaries on nested routes? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/remix/SKILL.md - pitfall 6: root ErrorBoundary must render full html document since no layout wraps it

tasks.prompt: Does Svelte 5 use a virtual DOM at runtime to apply updates, or does it compile components into direct DOM mutation code? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/svelte/SKILL.md - Compiler Model: Svelte is a compiler, no virtual DOM

tasks.prompt: To support SPA-style client-side routing with SvelteKit's static adapter and avoid 404s on direct URL access, what fallback file name do you configure? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/svelte/SKILL.md - pitfall 9: adapter fallback 200.html needed for SPA routing

tasks.prompt: In Svelte 5 runes mode, which rune must a child component use to declare a prop that the parent can bind to two-way? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/svelte/SKILL.md - Runes System and pitfall 4: bindable prop declared with the bindable rune

tasks.prompt: In Vue Single File Components, which compiler macro lets you set up two-way v-model binding without manually writing a separate prop and emit pair? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/vue/SKILL.md - Single-File Components: defineModel compiler macro

tasks.prompt: Vue 3.5 shipped a new reactivity engine. By roughly what percentage did it cut memory usage? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/vue/SKILL.md - Reactivity System: 56% memory reduction in the new engine

tasks.prompt: Vue's Vapor Mode, in beta as of version 3.6, is built on which named reactivity engine? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/frontend/skills/vue/SKILL.md - Vapor Mode section: Uses the Alien Signals reactivity engine
